messages:
Ethan: Quick sync — Pelorus-11B int8 onboard smoke results are in. Good token cost but seeing intermittent OOMs under mixed traffic.
Priya: numbers?
Ethan: single-run summary: 50k requests, overall OOM rate 0.06%, concentrated on long-context convo tests (ctx > 3k) when gen > 300. Short-form tasks fine.
Noah: likely fragmentation from aggressive prefetch + large max_new_tokens. What were the defaults?
Ethan: we used max_new_tokens=512, batch_window_ms=22, prefetch_limit=4096 (aggressive to keep p95 low). batch_cap 10.
Priya: can you paste the worker tail where it OOMs?
Ethan: snippet: ```
[2024-08-21T16:45:10Z] gen:start model=pelorus-11b-int8 ctx_len=3584 gen=420
[2024-08-21T16:45:10Z] alloc: requested_contig=1.15GB free_contig=720MB total_free=3.8GB
[2024-08-21T16:45:10Z] kv: prefetch queued=30 chunks avg=52KB
[2024-08-21T16:45:10Z] evict: freed 120MB
[2024-08-21T16:45:10Z] OOM: unable to find contiguous block, aborting
```
Noah: yep small chucks -> fragmentation. Quick mitigations to try: reduce prefetch_limit, lower max_new_tokens default for convos, enable slot_compactor at low aggressiveness. Also consider allocator.reserved_slab for int8.
Priya: proposed experiments (fast):
- set max_new_tokens=256 for convo endpoints
- prefetch_limit=1024
- batch_window_ms=12
- slot_compactor.compaction_threshold=0.6, compaction_rate=0.15
- allocator.reserved_slab=true (optional)
Ethan: running rbench: `rbench --model pelorus-11b-int8 --suite convo-long --concurrency 16 --batch-cap 10 --max_new_tokens 256 --prefetch_limit 1024 --batch_window_ms 12`
Perf-bot: queued perf run -> https://ci.internal/runs/9987 (artifacts uploaded)
Ethan: quick update after 12k requests: OOMs=0, coherence/regression on convo eval reduced from -3.8% to -0.8%, p95 latency +4% vs prior int8 but still ~25% lower than fp16.
Noah: good tradeoff. Next step: implement selective KV eviction policy for long prefixes (kv.evict_min_prefix=1024) so we keep short sessions cached. Also add a canary rollback if OOM > 0.03% or convo score drop > 1%.
Priya: I'll add these knobs to model-config template for pelorus-int8 and create onboarding checklist entry: "int8 convos: default max_new_tokens=256, prefetch_limit<=1024, batch_window_ms<=15, enable slot_compactor".
Infra-bot: Canary deployed -> pelorus-int8-canary-2024-08-21 targeting 8% traffic.
Ethan: monitoring dashboard link: https://ops.internal/canaries/pelorus-int8-canary. Will post results after 24h. :rocket:
